task.title: Update your Red Hat account information
task.shortdesc: You use your Red Hat account to log in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console. The following table lists information that you can update on your Red Hat account:

ul.li: You are logged in to the Hybrid Cloud Console. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .

step.cmd: To update your Red Hat account information, click your user avatar in the upper right of the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console window. A drop-down list appears.
Select a label under Your information or Your preferences.

entry.p: Update personal information including your name, email address, job title, and phone numbers.
Change your password and manage accounts connected to your company’s single sign-on (SSO). Note that you cannot change your Red Hat login after it has been created.
Change your preferred language and time zone.

Control which errata notifications you receive and when you receive them. Errata notifications are email notifications of security updates, bug fixes, and enhancements. Errata notifications are configured in Notification Preferences in the Hybrid Cloud Console.

step.cmd: Update your information and then click Save.
